source.name: Kosner: 'Kosner renueva con Baskonia hasta 2028'
source.quote: Además de mantener el nombre de Kosner Baskonia, nuestra marca seguirá presente en la parte frontal de la camiseta de juego
source.note: Renewal announced 9 Sep 2026 keeps Kosner as naming sponsor ('Kosner Baskonia') with front-of-shirt presence until 2028, covering 2026-27. Seen on the chest of the official 2026/27 home jersey in the club store's product photos (ACB 'full sponsor' version shows Kosner large on the chest; the EuroLeague version shows it smaller above KingRoyal.media).

source.name: Mundo Deportivo (EFE): KingRoyal Media, nuevo patrocinador principal en la camiseta del Baskonia
source.quote: es el nuevo patrocinador del Baskonia, que lucirá su marca en la parte frontal de su camiseta las dos próximas temporadas
source.note: Two-season deal from November 2025 covers 2026-27. Mundo Deportivo: KingRoyal.media alone on the front in EuroLeague games, sharing the front with Kosner in ACB games. 'kingroyal .media' is printed on the front of the official 2026/27 home jersey in the club store's and Macron retailers' product photos.

source.name: 2Playbook: Kosner Baskonia firma a Alamosa para la trasera del pantalón hasta la temporada 2029-2030
source.quote: la compañía alavesa lucirá su marca en la parte trasera del pantalón de juego del primer equipo durante los partidos de la Liga Endesa
source.note: Four-season deal (2026-27 to 2029-30) with Alavesa del Motor, S.A. (Alamosa); brand on the back of the game shorts in Liga Endesa games.

summary: Front of the 2026/27 home jersey: Kosner (naming sponsor 'Kosner Baskonia', renewed to 2028) and kingroyal.media (main sponsor since November 2025, alone on the front in EuroLeague games, shared with Kosner in ACB) — both confirmed by the announcements and by the official product photos of the Macron 2026/27 home singlet (club store and retailers), which also show only the Macron mark, the club crest and the Liga Endesa / EuroLeague Abu Dhabi competition badges elsewhere. Back of the shorts: Alamosa from 2026-27 (Liga Endesa games). Not marked complete: no source checked shows the back of the 2026/27 game jersey — in 2025-26 Grupo Amutio held the upper back and Vitoria-Gasteiz the lower (2Playbook, 13 Nov 2025), but no 2026-27 confirmation was found; the retail replica's back is plain.
